svg.title: One data set, five views
svg.desc: One year of simulated bike-share trips shown five ways: a bar chart of the busiest stations, a heatmap of trips by weekday and hour with commute peaks, a map of stations along a river, a network of trips between stations, and a time series of daily trips that peaks in summer.

g.text: average trips per hour, weekday by hour
Weekdays: 8 AM and 5 PM commute peaks.
Summer peak, rainy-day dips, weekly rhythm.
